[Rating: 2/10] - Very frustrating - Took everything that made Ticket to Ride fun and made it complicated for no reason. Why limit players to draw adjacent cards ? Why force players to play a card to start their movement ? Why are those cards you slide below your board not counted as extra movement cards ?  - Everything feels slow. Objectives are so long to complete for barely any bonus other than points and a drawn a card.

[Rating: 3/10] Its a very nice game. Looks fantastic, easy to learn but changeling but also no fun at all. The first couple of games is fun but when everyone figuring out that it just about blocking each other. The one who succeeds the best wins. Simple like that. If you like those kinds of games, buy Dewan.

[Rating: 4/10] There's nothing wrong with it. And, yes, the box art looks great. But is it fun to play? It's in no way offensive, might be nice for families with kids. Don't particularly want to play it again.

[Rating: 4/10] For some reason they decided not to add pigment icons onto the cards. Giving tucking cards is an important part of the game to obtain resources other players have made it impossible to get this decision just makes for a frustrating and annoying game. Every single other story tile objective is available to be tucked so no idea why they left this off.

[Rating: 4/10] A lot of luck of the draw when it comes to the cards and the "story tiles". If you happen to get story  tiles that overlap requirements and your opponent doesn't, there is little they can do. Especially because you don't have the time to fully wait as to when to choose your next story tile. The cards are the same story - we didn't have a single mountain terrain come up for the last third of the game.   It also has a rich get richer problem. If you fall behind, there is very little you can do to catch up.

[Rating: 4/10] Speelt snel met snelle setup. Area control.   De acties en beslissingen zijn pover.  Ofwel 2 kaarten nemen ofwel een kamp plaatsen.  Dan opdrachten vervullen op de kaarten nazrgelang welke resources en tiles je bezet. Niet vernieuwend genoeg en dan speel ik liever ticket to ride, die hetzelfde opzet beoogt.

[Rating: 4/10] Nothing new, and it's too match symbols-y. Why add this to of all things, a tile placement game?

[Rating: 5/10] Area majority game that is okay - it plays pretty quickly but there's nothing that sets this apart from others or makes it particularly fun/entertaining. Some timing to consider, especially if the cards on offer don't jive well with where you've already built.
